message.content: The consensus among critics and audiences alike points to **“Nomadland”** as the standout film of 2020. Directed by Chloé Zhao, the movie follows a woman who leaves her small town after the economic collapse of her community and travels across the American West. Its understated storytelling, powerful performances (especially Frances McDormand), and poignant exploration of modern American life earned it widespread acclaim, culminating in winning the Academy Award for Best Picture in 2021. While other strong contenders from that year include “The Father,” “The Trial of the Chicago 7,” and “Minari,” “Nomadland” is generally regarded as the best overall film released in 2020.
